pages.title: Setup and mounting
pages.text: The Wafer Assembler designs and completes circuits. Install it in a sealed cleanroom and supply power for circuit operation.$(br2)Right-click the block while holding a wafer to mount it, then right-click again to open the editor. Check cleanliness before editing.

pages.title: Placing and reclaiming
pages.text: Pick up material from the inventory and left-click an empty cell to place a wire, gate, or completed lower-tier wafer. Left-click an occupied cell with an empty cursor to return its material to the inventory.$(br2)Poor cleanliness can contaminate cells during editing. Contaminated cells cannot be edited.

pages.title: Settings and history
pages.text: Right-click a gate to rotate it or a wire to cycle connection modes. Hold redstone and right-click a Signal Drop gate to adjust its drop amount.$(br2)Undo and redo restore settings such as rotations and pin modes. Placing or reclaiming components clears this history.

pages.title: Pins and signals
pages.text: Click the edge pins to cycle input, output, and disabled modes. North and west default to inputs; east and south default to outputs. These directions refer to the world compass.$(br2)Wire materials attenuate signals differently. Hover over cells to inspect their signals and settings.

pages.title: Trace materials
pages.text: Along a continuous trace of one material, signal strength drops by 1 at these intervals:$(br)Redstone dust: 1 cell$(br)Copper nugget: 2 cells$(br)Lead nugget: 3 cells$(br)Silver nugget: 4 cells$(br)Gold nugget: 6 cells$(br2)A direct connection between different trace materials halves the signal strength, rounding down.

pages.title: Trace shapes
pages.text: Right-click a trace to cycle its shape. A + junction joins all four directions. An insulated crossover keeps the horizontal and vertical signals separate.$(br2)Use straight and corner shapes to limit connections to the intended directions. Hover over a trace to check its shape and signals.

pages.title: Completion and nesting
pages.text: Optionally enter a name, then press Finish. Further edits mark the wafer unfinished again. Sneak-right-click the block with an empty hand to retrieve it.$(br2)Embed completed lower-tier wafers in higher-tier designs to reuse them. An insertion that exceeds the complexity limit leaves the material untouched.
